evidence.quote: ライブラリからの起動も出来ず

next_investigation_steps_en: Pull startup and crash logs by build, operating system and installed modifications.
Reproduce library launch and freeze reports on affected configurations.
Measure relaunch and recovery outcomes after the identified failures.
cards.not_established_en: The data do not identify startup or crash root causes, establish prevalence outside negative reviewers, or estimate repair ROI. Few sample positives limit confidence despite stronger classifier performance.

cards.title_en: Difficulty feels excessive and unfriendly to beginners
cards.what_players_report_en: Players describe the game as too difficult and lacking consideration for beginners. One says the difficulty leaves them unable to do anything.
cards.scale_en: Among the game's negative reviews, sample tier: 4.2% (17 of 408 random negative reviews; 90% CI 2.8%–6.1%). Pooled classifier-adjusted diagnostic: 3.8%; held-out classifier F1: 0.58, lowering confidence in classifier-tier numbers. No clear sustained annual trend in the supplied raw classifier-flagged shares.
cards.retention_signal_en: Adjusted association among negative reviewers, flagged versus other negative reviewers: +3.6 pp (90% CI +1.0 to +6.3) in the share whose last play was at least 30 days after the review. This is not a causal effect; weak classification also limits interpretation of the flagged group. Additional retention CI caution: not estimated.

evidence.quote: 这游戏太难了，什么都做不了
evidence.translation_en: This game is too hard; I can't do anything.

evidence.quote: 초보한테배려가없는게임
evidence.translation_en: A game with no consideration for beginners.

next_investigation_steps_en: Ask players which difficulty mode, progression stage and encounters caused problems.
Pull deaths, retries and progression stalls by encounter and player experience.
Observe beginner sessions and manually audit classifier errors separating difficulty from missing guidance.
cards.not_established_en: The data do not establish encounter imbalance or its root cause, prevalence outside negative reviewers, or repair ROI. Few sample positives, a relatively wide interval and classifier F1 below the requested threshold warrant low confidence.

cards.what_players_report_en: Players criticize combat and describe play as repetitive or tedious. One describes spending time sitting in a castle and waiting.
cards.scale_en: Among the game's negative reviews, sample tier: 2.9% (12 of 408 random negative reviews; 90% CI 1.8%–4.7%). Pooled classifier-adjusted diagnostic: ≈0% (the pooled misclassification correction is uninformative for this title). Prefer the sample tier; this does not mean nobody complains. Held-out classifier F1: 0.62. Raw classifier-flagged share, not misclassification-adjusted, generally declined from 7.3% in 2015 to 3.0% in 2023.
cards.retention_signal_en: Adjusted association among negative reviewers, flagged versus other negative reviewers: -9.8 pp (90% CI -11.9 to -7.6) in the share whose last play was at least 30 days after the review. This is not a causal effect. Additional retention CI caution: not estimated.

next_investigation_steps_en: Ask reviewers which combat actions and progression loops felt repetitive.
Observe relevant sessions and measure time spent fighting, repeating tasks and waiting.
Reproduce the identified encounters and collect feedback by weapon, progression stage and input device.
cards.not_established_en: The data do not identify the cause of unsatisfying combat or repetition, establish prevalence outside negative reviewers, or estimate repair ROI. Few sample positives, limited classifier quality and an uninformative correction warrant low confidence.

cards.what_players_report_en: Players describe the game as unfriendly to newcomers and lacking prompts. One says they play with a wiki open alongside the game.
cards.scale_en: Among the game's negative reviews, sample tier: 3.4% (14 of 408 random negative reviews; 90% CI 2.2%–5.2%). Pooled classifier-adjusted diagnostic: 4.4%; held-out classifier F1: 0.69. No clear sustained annual trend in the supplied raw classifier-flagged shares.
cards.retention_signal_en: Adjusted association among negative reviewers, flagged versus other negative reviewers: -8.5 pp (90% CI -10.8 to -6.2) in the share whose last play was at least 30 days after the review. This is not a causal effect. Additional retention CI caution: not estimated.

evidence.quote: играть параллельно с открытой википедией
evidence.translation_en: To play with Wikipedia open alongside.

next_investigation_steps_en: Observe first-time players and record unclear goals, failed actions and external lookups.
Pull early progression and help-interaction logs to locate stalls.
Ask complainants which missing instructions mattered, then test whether existing guidance answers those questions.
cards.not_established_en: The data do not establish which guidance failures caused disengagement, prevalence outside negative reviewers, or repair ROI. Few sample positives, relative interval width and moderate classifier quality warrant low confidence.
